description: Compatibility discovery catalog. Entries describe integration targets, not guaranteed support for every model.

protocols.name: Matter
protocols.notes: Requires Matter controller and compatible device.

protocols.name: Local network APIs
protocols.notes: Only documented/authenticated APIs supported by the device.

protocols.name: WebSocket integrations
protocols.notes: Requires a vendor or hub endpoint and credentials stored server-side.

protocols.name: IR/RF bridge
protocols.notes: Requires compatible hardware; not every IR/RF code is available.

protocols.name: Zigbee
protocols.notes: Requires a compatible coordinator and device profile.

protocols.name: Z-Wave
protocols.notes: Requires a compatible controller and regional frequency support.

protocols.name: Manufacturer cloud API
protocols.notes: Requires official API access, supported model and user authorization.

safety: Never mark a device available until its exact model, transport, authorization and command capabilities have been verified.
